title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-07

ai_review.summary: A superb soundboard capture of the Feb 7 1970 Fillmore West show, highlighted by Garcia’s pedal‑steel country set and smoking performances of China Cat Sunflower/IKYR, High Time, Uncle John’s Band into Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard mix that lets Garcia’s rich pedal‑steel tone and effortless leads shine, while the band delivers strong early C&W numbers followed by standout renditions of China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, High Time, Uncle John’s Band and Black Peter.  A few reviewers note minor hiss or occasional sound glitches, but overall the performance is praised as a high‑point of the spring‑1970 era.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (5/6) give five stars, praising both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only one review is mixed and notes minor sound issues, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced mix with rich guitar tone; a few listeners mention slight hiss or occasional dropouts but the transfer is generally praised as clean and enjoyable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert opens with a surprising three‑song country & western mini‑set featuring Garcia on pedal steel, then moves into classic mid‑era material.  The middle of the set (China Cat Sunflower/IKYR, High Time) is praised as excellent, while some listeners feel the latter half loses momentum, though most still highlight the mellow Uncle John’s Band → Black Peter transition.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s pedal‑steel work and rich, full guitar tone are repeatedly lauded; his leads are described as effortless and on point.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s vocal contribution to Uncle John's Band is noted as distinct for this period.
